title: Editor property catalog omits generator-supported accept_while_busy
description:
The current generator accepts accept_while_busy:boolean for inherited, switch, text, number and light properties, but the template-derived editor catalog omits it in all five contexts. This is source-confirmed on baseline af219db21 before this task and remains the single full editor attribute-contract failure after requested device-id/SDK-discover fixes. Next: scoped template/catalog correction with property context tests; no generator change or risk acceptance.

Imported from .factory/findings/active/FND-20261102201622-853f-fix-editor-build-doc-findings-001.json (category: quality, blocking: no).

outcome.summary: Core fix is correct: indigo_generator.c parse_property_block (lines 755-816) accepts accept_while_busy via parse_bool_attribute for all five kinds (text/number/switch/light/inherited, outside the type[0] != 'i' block), and template.driver now lists it as @type=boolean in all five contexts. Verified: test_editor 44 run, OK, 16 skipped (no build/bin/indigo_generator in worktree); rerun with a scratch-built unchanged generator: 44 run, 0 skipped, OK. Against master's template both the new test (KeyError) and test_template_matches_generator_attribute_contexts (FAIL) fail, so the test is effective. git diff --check clean, tabs used. DRIVER_GENERATOR_BASICS.md:199 already documents the attribute; no doc update needed. Two small corrections requested on the added lines: (1) template.driver:178,213,261,308 use example value 'false', but in inherited/switch/text/number every other default-false boolean uses 'true' as the example (persistent, pass_through_change, always_defined, preserve_values) and the default-true asynchronous_change uses 'false'. static/app.js:394-395 preselects the example in the add-attribute row, so the editor offers a no-op 'accept_while_busy = false;' by default. Use 'true' in those four contexts (light at :358 follows its own all-false convention and may stay). (2) The help text 'accept a change request while the property is BUSY' is shown as the editor tooltip (driver_format.py:296-300, app.js:390) and is untrue for every property except GUIDER_GUIDE_RA/GUIDER_GUIDE_DEC, according to indigo_docs/DRIVER_GENERATOR_BASICS.md:554 known issue 3 and indigo_generator.c:2124-2130. State that limitation in the help text, e.g. 'effective only on GUIDER_GUIDE_RA/GUIDER_GUIDE_DEC'. Non-blocking: the edit() half of the new test passes even without the fix (edit does not consult the catalog); only the catalog assertions make it effective.

Round 2 recheck of 8292c0358: both corrections applied. In template.driver the example is true in inherited/switch/text/number (:178,:213,:261,:308), consistent with the other default-false booleans there, and false in light (:358), consistent with that context's all-false examples and its 'optional attribute; ... (bool literal).' wording. The help text now says 'effective only on GUIDER_GUIDE_RA and GUIDER_GUIDE_DEC', matching indigo_generator.c:2124-2130 and DRIVER_GENERATOR_BASICS.md:554 known issue 3. schema() parses all five entries as type boolean with that help. Nothing else changed: git diff master shows only template.driver +5 and test_editor.py +11, and test_editor.py is identical to round 1. git diff --check is clean. test_editor: 44 run, OK, 16 skipped (no build/bin/indigo_generator in worktree); with a scratch-built unchanged generator: 44 run, 0 skipped, OK. Round 1 showed the new test and the attribute-contract test both fail on master's template. Not checked: editor UI in a browser. Remaining note (not blocking): the edit() half of the new test does not depend on the fix.
